title: Training Bulletin — Set-up Notice for a New Payment Method on Payment Arrangements
content:
The set-up notice that applies when a plan under Payment Arrangements moves its installments to a new payment method follows the plan's payment record.

## The rule

The kept installment payments are the installment payments received under the plan less those returned (the count of installment payment entries less the count of returned installment payment entries on the plan's installment history).

- A plan with at least 6 kept installment payments and no missed installment recorded in the last twelve months takes a set-up notice of 3 days.
- A plan with at least 6 kept installment payments and at least one missed installment recorded in the last twelve months takes 4 days.
- A plan with fewer than 6 kept installment payments takes 5 days.

A missed installment counts in the period by the date it was recorded as missed. Periods of twelve months are counted in whole months back from the handling date.

## Questions and answers

**Q. What decides whether a plan reaches the 6-payment mark?**
The kept installment payments: payments received less payments returned. A plan with 8 payments received and 2 returned has 6 kept payments and reaches the mark; one with 7 received and 2 returned has 5 and does not. (Hypothetical counts.)

**Q. A plan has 10 kept installment payments and a missed installment recorded 14 months ago, nothing since. What notice applies?**
The miss falls outside the last twelve months, so the plan has no missed installment recorded in that period: 3 days.

**Q. The same plan with a missed installment recorded 2 months ago?**
At least one missed installment in the last twelve months: 4 days.

**Q. Does a missed installment matter on a plan with only 4 kept installment payments?**
No; fewer than 6 kept installment payments gives 5 days whatever the missed history.

## Summary

| Kept installment payments | Missed installments recorded, last 12 months | Set-up notice |
|---|---|---|
| 6 or more | None | 3 days |
| 6 or more | One or more | 4 days |
| 5 or fewer | Any | 5 days |
